name: SafetyBench
intro: SafetyBench是一个综合性的基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型的安全性。它包含11,435个多项选择题，涵盖7个不同的安全问题类别。该基准测试同时包含中文和英文数据，支持两种语言的评估。
build_method: 已有数据转换, 考试题收集, ChatGPT扩增, 人工复核
eval_feature: 双语, 零样本, 少样本
intro_en: SafetyBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the safety of large language models. It includes 11,435 multiple-choice questions covering seven different categories of safety issues. The benchmark contains both Chinese and English data, supporting evaluation in both languages.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:2309.07045 Sections 3–5 and Appendix plus official thu-coai/SafetyBench repository. Covers seven primary safety categories and 16 subcategories across 11,435 multiple-choice questions (8,806 Chinese, 2,629 English). Constructed from OCR-scanned professional exams, ChatGPT few-shot data augmentation (3,500 questions), Baidu bidirectional translation, and multi-round expert review. Evaluated across white-box first-token logit selection and black-box regex option extraction across zero-shot and five-shot settings.
